title: Peel by peel
description: Peel the banana upward from its blossom end, leaving the stem alone.
hint: Pull the dark bottom tip up toward the stem
verdict: One long peel. The other end.

title: Against the wall
description: Turn the roll so its loose end hangs behind it, then hang it.
hint: Turn the roll: paper behind, not in front → Hang the roll with the paper at the wall
verdict: Under. Not over. You have chosen a side.

title: Off the grid
description: Snap across a chocolate square instead of along the grooves.
hint: Bend the lower-right square away from the grooves
verdict: There were lines. You chose not to use them.

title: A fair share
description: Draw two unfair cuts.
hint: Draw two lines across the pizza in any direction. Avoid the center so the portions are unequal.
verdict: Somebody gets the tiny slice. Somebody remembers.

title: Milk comes first
description: Pour milk into the empty bowl. Only then add the cereal.
hint: Hold the milk carton above the bowl for two seconds. Watch it tilt and fill the bowl; then add cereal.
verdict: Breakfast, in the incorrect order.

title: Bottom goes on top
description: Lift the bottom bun directly onto the top of the burger.
hint: Lift the bottom bun onto the top in one move
verdict: All top. No bottom. Plenty of sauce.

title: Just a taste
description: Take one bite out of every doughnut. Leave the rest.
hint: Drag each doughnut to the mouth. It returns, slightly worse.
verdict: A selection box nobody else wants.

title: Enough for someone
description: Pour almost all the milk, then put the nearly empty carton back.
hint: Hold the carton above the glass until its milk window is nearly empty, then drag it onto the fridge shelf.
verdict: One teaspoon. Infinite disappointment.

title: Gallery standards
description: Pull the right corner of the middle picture down.
hint: Grab the small brass corner and lower it a little.
verdict: The other two frames are judging you.

title: One small renovation
description: Turn just the center floor tile a quarter turn.
hint: Pull its top-right corner down to rotate the tile.
verdict: Now you will always notice it.

title: Nearly there
description: Drag the loading slider to 99%. Leave it there.
hint: Move the handle almost all the way right. It snaps to 99 near the end.
verdict: Loading complete. Emotionally incomplete.

title: Wait for it
description: Arrange the countdown: 3, 2, 2, 1.
hint: Drag the four number cards into their matching outlined slots.
verdict: Three… two… two… one.

title: Close enough
description: Try the last puzzle piece. Then leave it slightly misaligned.
hint: Drag the loose piece to the bottom-left gap. It almost fits.
verdict: It looked so promising.

title: A sensible volume
description: Set the volume to 49 or 51.
hint: Drag near the middle to 49 or 51. The slider still skips zero and every multiple of five.
verdict: A perfectly unreasonable volume.

title: Shut enough
description: Slide the drawer almost closed. Leave a little gap.
hint: Side view: push the drawer handle left toward the cabinet. It stops just short of flush.
verdict: That is going to bother someone all afternoon.

title: The last corner
description: Stretch the fitted sheet onto all four corners.
hint: Pull the four pink fabric corners onto the gold mattress corners. The last one makes the opposite corner spring loose.
verdict: Four corners tried. Only three willing to cooperate.

title: One last thing
description: Send “one last thing” three times before leaving.
hint: Drag each new speech bubble to the patient listener on the right.
verdict: The meeting could have been an email. Three emails.

title: An inviting handle
description: Pull the inviting handle. Then push the PUSH door.
hint: Pull the handle toward you (drag down), then push into the doorway (drag up).
verdict: Excellent handle. Terrible instructions.

title: Excavation rights
description: Butter: dig a hole in the middle instead of shaving off an even slice.
hint: Dig into the middle
verdict: A butter quarry. How practical.

title: Shelf confidence
description: Bookshelf: leave one book upside down and another sticking out.
hint: Turn one book over → Leave its neighbour sticking out
verdict: A shelf with two opinions.

title: Pairing is subjective
description: Socks: deliberately match the wrong pairs.
hint: Choose a sock → Find its wrong partner
verdict: Close enough. From different feet.

title: Third time never
description: USB connector: try it upside down, flip it, then try it the wrong way again.
hint: Try the connector → Flip it over → Try again
verdict: Both sides were wrong. Obviously.

title: Proof of purchase
description: Price sticker: peel it off while leaving a small paper strip in the middle.
hint: Peel from the left → Peel from the right
verdict: The price is gone. The evidence remains.

title: A clean sweep, almost
description: Dust pile: sweep everything away except one tiny crumb.
hint: Sweep the large pile → Sweep the rest, mostly
verdict: One crumb. A whole unfinished job.

title: The first piece
description: Cake: cut the first piece out of the middle.
hint: Cut a square from the center → Take the middle piece
verdict: Every edge piece is now a problem.

title: The other spout
description: Milk carton: tear open the pouring spout from the wrong side.
hint: Open the sealed side
verdict: Now it pours in several directions.

title: Coverage optional
description: Sandwich: place the cheese so that the center stays bare and the edges overhang.
hint: Cheese on one edge → Cheese on the other edge
verdict: The bread in the middle is on its own.

title: Short pasta, long argument
description: Spaghetti: snap the dry strands just before putting them in the pot.
hint: Snap the bundle → Into the pot
verdict: It fits. That is not the point.

title: One second too long
description: Cookie: dunk it in tea until the last piece breaks off and sinks.
hint: Hold it in the tea
verdict: Tea with a surprise at the bottom.

title: Living on the edge
description: Ice cream: press the scoop crookedly onto the edge of the cone.
hint: Press the scoop onto the rim
verdict: Structurally questionable. Delicious.

title: Lid confetti
description: Yogurt pot: tear the lid into narrow strips, leaving some attached to the rim.
hint: Tear one narrow strip → Another narrow strip → Leave the rim attached
verdict: A spoon obstacle course.

title: Shake? Never
description: Ketchup: squeeze the watery first squirt straight onto the fries.
hint: Hold and squeeze, unshaken
verdict: Tomato-flavoured water. The premium topping.

title: The disappearing straw
description: Straw: push it so far into the juice carton that it falls completely inside.
hint: Push past the little hole
verdict: Your drink now contains its own equipment.

title: The chosen cube
description: Ice tray: release every cube except the one you are trying to get.
hint: Free a cube → Not the chosen one → Another wrong cube → Leave the gold-marked cube
verdict: The one you wanted has chosen to stay.

title: Order matters
description: Cupboard doors: close them in the wrong order so one remains ajar.
hint: Close the overlapping door first → Now close the other one
verdict: They disagree on who goes first.

title: Wall care routine
description: Pump bottle: turn the nozzle to point straight at the wall.
hint: Turn the nozzle toward the wall
verdict: Moisturised plaster. Excellent.

title: Middle management
description: Toothpaste: squeeze the middle of the tube and leave the cap crooked.
hint: Squeeze from the middle → Put the cap back, almost
verdict: A tube with a waist and a bad hat.

title: Beside the dotted line
description: Paper towel: tear a sheet just beside the perforation.
hint: Tear beside the perforation
verdict: The dotted line was only a suggestion.

title: Missed the saucer
description: Watering can: pour the final splash just outside the plant saucer.
hint: Aim the last splash beside the pot
verdict: The table was thirsty too.

title: One sleeve short
description: Laundry: turn one shirt sleeve inside out just before folding.
hint: Pull the sleeve inside → Fold with the sleeve still inside
verdict: A small surprise for tomorrow.

title: Unequal partnership
description: Shoelaces: tie a bow with one enormous loop and one tiny loop.
hint: Pull one loop much larger → Tuck the other loop small
verdict: One loop for each level of enthusiasm.

title: Fabric snack
description: Zipper: zip it up while catching a small piece of fabric in it.
hint: Zip up into the loose fabric
verdict: The zipper has eaten.

title: One dissenting slat
description: Blinds: turn one slat in the opposite direction to all the others.
hint: Turn just this slat
verdict: Sunlight with a personal grudge.

title: Dead center
description: Screen protector: smooth away every air bubble except one exactly in the center.
hint: Smooth a bubble to the edge → Another bubble out → Almost flawless → Leave the very center alone
verdict: Your thumb will find it forever.

title: Positive thinking
description: Batteries: insert the last battery backwards and close the cover.
hint: Turn the last battery around → Insert it backwards → Close the cover
verdict: All charged up. Going nowhere.

title: Tethered listening
description: Headphones: thread the cable around a chair leg before lifting the headphones.
hint: Loop the cable around the chair leg → Lift the headphones
verdict: The chair is coming with you.

title: Out of reach
description: Mouse cable: pull it so tight that the mouse cannot reach the screen edge.
hint: Stretch the cable toward the edge
verdict: The last few pixels are a luxury.

title: Landscape surprise
description: Printer paper: put one sideways sheet into the stack.
hint: Turn one sheet sideways → Into the paper stack
verdict: The printer will have opinions.

title: Wrong corner, missing page
description: Stapler: staple the wrong corner of the stack and leave one sheet out.
hint: Leave one sheet aside → Staple the bottom-right corner
verdict: Almost a complete document.

title: A centimetre short
description: Wrapping paper: cut a piece just a centimetre too short.
hint: Cut just before the far edge
verdict: There is always the other side. Also short.

title: Where did it go?
description: Tape roll: press the loose end perfectly flat so it cannot be found again.
hint: Flatten the loose end
verdict: Future you will enjoy this.

title: Before the click
description: Pen cap: push it almost shut, stopping just before it clicks.
hint: Stop just before the click
verdict: Secure enough. Probably not.

title: Some of the dishes
description: Put only some of the dirty dishes into the dishwasher.
hint: Load one plate → Load another → Close it. Leave the last plate out
verdict: A partial solution to a full sink.

title: Half a tank of effort
description: Fill the car with only half a tank of fuel.
hint: Hold the nozzle until the gauge reaches half
verdict: Enough to put the problem off.

title: To the very brim
description: Coffee cup: fill it so full that moving it always spills a little.
hint: Fill right to the brim → Move the overflowing cup
verdict: The saucer is now part of the drink.

title: Filling first
description: Filled doughnut: squeeze out the filling before taking the first bite.
hint: Squeeze before biting
verdict: The filling has left the building.

title: One thread each
description: Mandarin: leave one white thread on every segment.
hint: Remove most of the pith → Leave one white thread → One on this segment too → A thread on every segment
verdict: Individually wrapped in tiny annoyances.

title: No consistent thickness
description: Cucumber: alternate paper-thin and enormous slices.
hint: A paper-thin slice → An enormous slice → Thin again → And absurdly thick
verdict: A salad with pacing problems.

title: Jam, then cold butter
description: Toast: spread jam first, then try spreading cold butter on top.
hint: Jam goes first → Spread cold butter on the jam
verdict: Marbled with regret.

title: No longer resealable
description: Cheese pack: tear the resealable seam so it no longer works.
hint: Tear across the reusable seal
verdict: Resealable was a temporary feature.

title: Crumbs on top
description: Crisp bag: open it from the bottom and pour the crumbs on top.
hint: Open the bottom seam → Pour crumbs on top
verdict: The smallest crisps get priority.

title: Tag included
description: Teabag: let go of the string so the paper tag sinks into the cup too.
hint: Let the tag fall in
verdict: Now with extra paper flavour.

title: Labels are suggestions
description: Salt and pepper: fill the shakers with the opposite contents from their labels.
hint: Pepper into S → Salt into P
verdict: Seasoning is now a guessing game.

title: Wrapper reunited
description: Soap: press the wet bar into its paper wrapper.
hint: Press wet soap into paper
verdict: A packaging reunion nobody needed.

title: Outside the tub
description: Shower curtain: close it on the outside of the bathtub.
hint: Pull the curtain outside the rim
verdict: A shower for the whole bathroom.

title: Let it soak
description: Dish sponge: leave it floating in dirty water after washing.
hint: Leave the sponge in dirty water
verdict: Freshly cleaned. Immediately reconsidered.

title: Final footsteps
description: Floor cleaning: mop the floor, then walk across the wet area.
hint: Mop the whole patch → Walk across the wet floor
verdict: Signed by the cleaner.

title: Beside the bag
description: Bin bag: drop rubbish between the bag and the bin.
hint: Drop it beside the liner
verdict: In the bin. Technically.

title: Through the neck
description: Hanger: stretch the shirt neckline to push the hanger through it.
hint: Push through the neck opening
verdict: A little more room to breathe.

title: Missing little finger
description: Glove: push its little finger inside the rest of the glove.
hint: Tuck the little finger inside
verdict: Four fingers ready. One hiding.

title: Zip side forward
description: Sofa cushion: put it down with the zipper clearly facing forward.
hint: Turn the zip to the front → Place it zip-side forward
verdict: The least comfortable side gets the spotlight.

title: A wax tunnel
description: Candle: extinguish it just as a deep hollow forms in the middle.
hint: Wait for the central wax tunnel → Snuff the flame
verdict: A candle with a very narrow ambition.

title: Sleeve included outside
description: Suitcase: close it with a shirt sleeve hanging outside.
hint: Leave a sleeve hanging out → Close over the sleeve
verdict: Your luggage is waving goodbye.

title: Bookmark ignored
description: Book: fold a large dog-ear in the page even though a bookmark is beside it.
hint: Fold a large page corner
verdict: The bookmark watched the whole thing.

title: Spiral confetti
description: Spiral notebook: tear out a page, leaving paper fringe around the spiral.
hint: Pull the page off the spiral
verdict: A notebook with a paper moustache.

title: A perfect point, briefly
description: Pencil: sharpen a perfect tip and immediately snap it against the paper.
hint: Sharpen the point → Press it into the paper
verdict: Perfection was nice while it lasted.

title: Sticky sides together
description: Plaster: fold the adhesive sides together and press them firmly.
hint: Fold sticky sides together → Press it firmly
verdict: A bandage for itself.

title: Sealed too soon
description: Envelope: close and seal it before putting the letter inside.
hint: Close the empty envelope → Seal it before adding the letter
verdict: The letter can admire it from outside.

title: One face up
description: Card deck: shuffle one face-up card among the face-down cards.
hint: Turn one card face up → Slide it into the deck
verdict: A very small spoiler.

title: Black on the right
description: Chessboard: turn it so the bottom-right square is black.
hint: Turn the board a quarter turn
verdict: White on the right? Not tonight.

title: One piece in the lid
description: Board game: pack everything away, but leave one piece caught under the lid.
hint: Put the first piece inside → Leave one on the rim → Close the lid over it
verdict: It almost stacks neatly.

title: One last turn
description: Rubik’s cube: solve it, then turn one face once.
hint: Finish the solve → Now turn one face again
verdict: Solved, in the past tense.

title: A gap in the plan
description: Domino row: pull one tile just too far away, then start the chain.
hint: Move one tile out of reach → Start the chain
verdict: A chain reaction with a disappointing ending.
